newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Silicon Graphics raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Silicon Graphics raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said it raised its rating for Silicon Graphics Inc to buy from long-term buy.

-- "We believe that impending earnings improvements, attributable to the recovery of SGI's execution of its business, has become sufficiently visible to boost our confidence over the threshold we need to recommend the stock more aggressively," analysts Daniel Kuntsler and Rahul Narang wrote in a report.
-- set a target price per share of $35.
-- shares rose 3/4 to 26-3/8 in mid-morning trade.
